purpose: Policy-facing ANC evidence explorer combining observed attendance and equity patterns with frozen predictive-model performance and explainability evidence.
primary_outcome_definition: Attainment of 8 or more ANC contacts

survey_design.proportion_CI: Taylor-linearized survey proportion with logit confidence interval

attendance_definition.interpretation: Final reported ANC contact attainment; not longitudinal dropout or missed-appointment history.

travel_time_groups.interpretation: Empirical descriptive bands; not clinical thresholds.

evidence_layers: Observed survey-weighted ANC attendance and pathway evidence
Frozen Notebook 3 permutation and SHAP evidence
model_interpretation_boundary: Prediction-model importance, SHAP values and model-response contrasts describe fitted-model behavior and do not establish causal effects.
programme_interpretation_boundary: Programme-review cues identify questions and options for further review; they are not intervention-effect estimates or resource-allocation priorities.

raw_source.notebook4_use: Restricted extraction of caseid and m14_1 only, followed by one-to-one alignment with the frozen Notebook 1 cohort.
raw_source.boundary: Notebook 4 did not recreate Notebook 1 preprocessing from the raw file.
